name: databasecraft
description: L3 Native Desktop UI application for DatabaseCraft (ArtCraft egui/eframe pattern)

tools.name: db_status
tools.description: Get DatabaseCraft status, table count, and registered control port 14113

tools.name: db_query
tools.description: Execute a SQL query against the DatabaseCraft store and retrieve structured records

tools.name: db_schema_inspect
tools.description: Inspect database schema, foreign keys, and column definitions across all tables or a specific table

tools.name: db_record_insert
tools.description: Insert a structured JSON record into a table

tools.name: db_export_merge
tools.description: Query database and format rows for another Craft family member (designcraft, deckcraft, wordcraft, gridcraft, pdfcraft)

tools.name: db_seed_demo
tools.description: Seed deterministic demo dataset (ecommerce, film, kpi) for testing multi-app flows

tools.name: db_vector_search
tools.description: Execute a dense vector similarity search (cosine, dot_product, l2) over an embedded vector table

tools.name: db_hybrid_search
tools.description: Execute a hybrid RAG search combining dense vectors and sparse BM25 text keywords with Reciprocal Rank Fusion

tools.name: db_rag_embed
tools.description: Generate deterministic in-process semantic float vector embedding from text string

tools.name: db_semantic_search
tools.description: Execute end-to-end semantic search using natural language text query (in-process embedding + hybrid RRF or vector search)

tools.name: db_nlq
tools.description: Translate natural language prompt into schema-aware SQLite query with explanation and safety fences

tools.name: db_semantic_dedupe
tools.description: Analyze text column to find near-duplicate records using vector similarity clustering

tools.name: db_schema_advisor
tools.description: Inspect database schema for missing foreign key indexes, missing primary keys, and FTS5 candidates

tools.name: db_generate_synthetic
tools.description: Generate realistic domain-specific synthetic rows matching column types and foreign key references

tools.name: db_ingest_document
tools.description: Chunk unstructured markdown/text into sections and ingest into relational, vector, and FTS5 tables

tools.name: db_data_profile
tools.description: Profile table columns for distinct cardinality, null ratios, min/max values, and data types

tools.name: db_vacuum
tools.description: Defragment and reclaim unused disk space in database

tools.name: db_backup
tools.description: Create atomic online backup file of current database

tools.name: db_diagnose
tools.description: Inspect B-tree pages and foreign key relationships to detect database damage or inconsistencies

tools.name: db_repair
tools.description: Repair database: reindex B-trees, purge orphaned foreign keys, or salvage records to clean clone

tools.name: db_construct
tools.description: Construct a turnkey domain database schema: small_business, club, surgery, or creative_agency

tools.name: db_list_blueprints
tools.description: List all turnkey domain database blueprints available for instant construction

tools.name: canvas_query
tools.description: Execute a hierarchical Relational Canvas perspective query with nested subqueries and rollups (Ultorg-style Non-1NF)

tools.name: canvas_compile
tools.description: Compile a Relational Canvas perspective specification into ANSI/SQLite JSON SQL without executing

tools.name: db_schema_relations
tools.description: Inspect forward (N:1) and reverse (1:N) foreign-key relationships for a table to discover suggested joins and compact joins

tools.name: db_notifications_list
tools.description: List operational health notifications, disk space warnings, and quiescence anomalies

tools.name: db_notification_ack
tools.description: Acknowledge an operational alert or notification by ID

tools.name: db_watchdog_check
tools.description: Run CTO watchdog anomaly evaluation across database (evaluates quiescence violations, integrity, disk)

tools.name: db_update_cell
tools.description: Atomically update a single table cell identified by its primary key with validation, mutation tracking, and notification bus event
